history.name: End-to-end test of the real command line
history.description: One test builds a project from nothing in a temporary directory and drives the real command line through it: every write, both documents and the printed edition, and each guardrail exercised from the side that is meant to be refused as well as the side that is meant to work. Nothing is stubbed, because the record is files on disk and a test that replaces the filesystem stops testing the thing.
history.dev_notes: test/smoke.mjs, run by `npm test`; the workspace is kept on failure so it can be inspected.
